lead: nine years ago a woman said one sentence about her sister in a kitchen you were passing through. you have kept them apart at every table since, and both of them let it go long ago.
sun: the sentence was not addressed to you and you were not in the conversation. the ear does not require either. it took the tone under the words, and from that evening the seating became yours to run — who sat where, which invitation went out late, which two errands got combined so that one car did both. nobody saw a decision, because a thing that does not happen leaves nothing to see.
moon: The Glance took it at the weight it went in at, and has not adjusted since. re-reading would mean letting go of the thing long enough to look, and nothing here lets go. so the injury keeps its opening size while the two who had it have gone on and made it up in some ordinary way, and nobody thought to tell you, since nobody knew you held it.
pull: nothing reaches you by invitation and nothing that reached you has been let go. you keep a nine-year-old injury at the size it was, for two people who put it down.
tension: someone asks why those two are never put together, and you have no answer. the honest one is a sentence you overheard in a kitchen and were never handed, and repeating it would do the damage that has not happened yet. so you say something about the numbers and the table, and it sounds like fussiness, and fussiness is what the family has settled on. it is the mildest thing they could have decided about you.
cost: a doorway, a coat still half off, and you have the shape of the evening — who has been arguing in the car, which pairing will not hold past nine. nobody taught you that and nobody can see you doing it. what it has produced, over a decade, is a woman being guarded against a remark she forgave in her forties, by the only person still holding it.

lead: the name over the door was your grandmother's, and you have known since you were nineteen exactly what the senior staff think about that, in their own words, none of which were said to you.
sun: you know what the place actually needs, and it is rarely what the meeting is about, so you go and do that. the ledger nobody reconciled. the manager who was about to walk. it gets done before it has a name, which is the only way you know how, and the result is a firm that runs and an inheritor with nothing on paper that would carry a signature.
moon: the seat came carved. it holds you level in a room, it stops your face doing anything when the assessment lands, and it asks, privately, on a loop, whether the person in it would have got there otherwise. that question would be settled by a record of what you have done, and your way of working consumes the record while making it.
pull: the firm runs because of you and the record cannot show it, and the only room where that would count is the one inside you, asking the same question it asked at nineteen.
tension: pleasant enough, not the grandmother, carried by the name — that is the settled view, and the people holding it are working from what is visible, which is a calm person in a good chair. years of things that did not go wrong are not in the visible category. you could correct the whole of it in one afternoon, and correcting it would mean saying out loud that you had heard them.
cost: a supplier decides to leave a long time before he mentions it, and you have heard it and dealt with it inside the week, on the phone, with no paper anywhere. eighteen years of that reads as a firm that was always steady. the one legible fact on the record is the name, and the name was there before you.

lead: the first thing anyone learns about you is that you are the one to go to, and it is said at a volume you did not set, and by the end of the week they have your number.
sun: what people bring is never the item they name. they come with a scheduling problem and the actual matter is in the second sentence, and you have it before they finish. so you handle the actual matter, quietly, and give them an answer about the schedule. they leave satisfied and describe you afterwards as easy to talk to, which is a description of The Mane, and not of anything that happened past it.
moon: the spread was never set by you. it reads as plenty from the far side of a hall, so people arrive already assuming there is room in you for whatever they have, and nothing at that size gets knocked on first. the reputation is for noticing, and the noticing costs nothing, since it happens whether or not you attend to it.
pull: you are known for the half that was free. the half with a price on it has no audience, no name, and no way of getting one without your saying so.
tension: the praise that comes back is generous, said warmly, and it misses. generous describes a person choosing to give. the arriving happens without a choice and the handling happens because you already know, and neither of those is a decision at all. so the praise lands on a reflex, and the fortnight of actual effort behind the thing they are thanking you for goes unmentioned, because they never saw a fortnight.
cost: newcomers are settled inside a month here, disputes come apart before they are disputes, and everybody's account of why is that you are wonderful with people. the size arrived without your consent and does the recruiting, the ear takes whatever the recruiting brings, and the part that takes evenings has no shape anyone can point at.

lead: eleven months after you left, the department came apart in a way nobody could account for, and the review put it down to a difficult year and a run of bad luck with staffing.
sun: for nine years you heard which arrangement was under strain before it showed, and you shored it up — a conversation on a friday, two people kept off the same project, a resignation talked out of the room. none of that appeared anywhere. it could not: the work was to stop things becoming events, and an event that does not occur has no entry, no owner, and nobody to hand it on to.
moon: when you went, you went completely — no consulting arrangement, no lunch every few months, the whole nine years off in one season with nothing kept. what does not come off is what was still owed. two of them still ring, and you still take it, because the ear went on receiving the place long after you stopped having any way to act on what it brought.
pull: you can end a life completely and still be the only person who knows why the place is failing, and no sentence exists that would get it from you to them.
tension: your successor is competent and is being blamed. nothing was withheld from her at the handover; there was no file, because the work never produced one. the version circulating now is that you saw it coming and got out — that you always did know when to go. the one thing the place could always see about you is being used as evidence of something you never did.
cost: nine years without a crisis, in a place that generated one every quarter before you and has generated four since. an ending here takes everything, and the one thing it cannot take is the receiving, so you are still getting the place's news in a house with no connection to it, at the same resolution, with no standing left to use any of it.
